solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: This person is about to drown in wine, regretting being away

indicators.note: to drown in something is to be plunged inside it, so these letters go into the wine

parts.note: hock is a German white wine from the Rhine
the setter calls themself 'this person', which gives ME

indicators.note: about means the word is is turned round

explanation.surface: A homesick drinker abroad, about to sink their sorrows in a glass of wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This person' is the setter, a crossword convention. 'about' turns IS round, and 'to drown in' sinks it with ME inside a Rhine wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling sorrow at absence from one's own home is exactly that longing for home.

clue.text: Bob's aspiration

definitions.meaning: an aspiration is a wish or ambition

explanation.definitionFit: Bob Hope was an American comedian; an aspiration is an expectation or desire for something.

clue.text: Advocate of Communism to spoil mark on ballot paper

parts.note: to mar something is to spoil it
voters put a cross, X, on the ballot paper

explanation.surface: A communist voter defaces the ballot paper with a protest mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Karl Marx, co-author of the Communist Manifesto, was the chief theorist of that ideology.

clue.text: Fair treatment in Kent location after nine maybe

indicators.note: after puts the Kent town behind the number word

parts.note: nine is three times three, an example of a square number
Deal is a seaside town in Kent, a county in south-east England

explanation.surface: Someone hoping for fair dealing in a Kent town once the clock strikes nine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nine maybe' reads like a time of day; it is an example of a square number.
explanation.definitionFit: A square deal is an idiom for an honest, equitable arrangement.

clue.text: Tea served with tea dance

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
cha again, slang for tea

explanation.surface: A tea dance where cups of tea are handed round.
explanation.definitionFit: The cha-cha is a Latin American ballroom dance.

clue.text: Bird has titbits, losing time repeatedly

indicators.note: losing means these letters are taken out of the word titbits

parts.note: time is abbreviated T, and repeatedly means every T goes

explanation.surface: A bird gets its tasty morsels, though slowly over time.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibis is a long-legged wading bird with a curved bill.

clue.text: Jump over a railway line — that's the limit!

indicators.note: in a down clue, over places the jump above what follows

parts.note: to bound is to jump
RY is an abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: Someone leaping a railway track, and an exasperated onlooker calling it the last straw.
explanation.definitionFit: A boundary marks the furthest extent of something, its edge.

clue.text: Evil rites, nasty and disturbing

parts.note: sin is wrongdoing, evil

indicators.note: nasty suggests rites gone wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A description of some wicked, unpleasant occult ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evil' looks like the definition but gives SIN; 'nasty' rearranges RITES to ISTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sinister is threatening and unsettling, so it is disturbing.

clue.text: Left to join superior girl in the country

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
U stands for upper class, superior
gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: A girl from the upper set leaves to settle in some country.
explanation.definitionFit: Portugal is a nation on the Iberian peninsula.

clue.text: Performance gives a funny feeling

definitions.meaning: an act in a variety show
a brief spell of feeling unwell or odd

explanation.surface: A show that leaves the audience oddly unsettled.
explanation.definitionFit: A turn is a stage act, and also a sudden bout of faintness or shock.

clue.text: This person's getting important road permits for people entering country

parts.note: this person is, from the setter's view, I am, shortened to I'M
the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, its 1 read as the letter I
grants are permits or allowances

explanation.surface: An official obtaining permits to build a major road.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1, London to Leeds, is written MI, with the figure 1 standing in for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Immigrants are those arriving to settle in a nation.

clue.text: Famous Greek island possessed by cunning old people

indicators.note: possessed by means held inside the other pieces

parts.note: arch means sly or knowing
the Medes were an ancient people of Iran

explanation.surface: A Greek island owned by a crafty ancient race.
explanation.definitionFit: Archimedes of Syracuse was a renowned Greek mathematician and inventor.

clue.text: Composer with position set up — one who has completed university course?

definitions.text: one who has completed university course?

parts.note: J S Bach, the German composer

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the word is written upwards, backwards

parts.note: a role is a position or job

explanation.surface: A composer given a post, perhaps after graduating.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a bachelor is also an unmarried man; here it is a degree holder.
explanation.definitionFit: A bachelor's degree is awarded on finishing a first university course.

clue.text: Very pleased about English, very buoyed up?

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the abbreviations

parts.note: elated means delighted

explanation.surface: Someone thrilled by English success, their spirits lifted.
explanation.definitionFit: Raised up high, lifted; buoyed up suggests being held aloft.

clue.text: Refer everything impolite, not right

parts.note: all means everything

indicators.note: not right means the R is dropped from the word for impolite

parts.note: rude means impolite

explanation.surface: A complaint that everything said was rude, but not quite out of order.
explanation.definitionFit: To allude is to mention or make indirect reference.

clue.text: Make a hole through mass of stonework at front of church

indicators.note: at front of places the stonework before the church letters

parts.note: a pier is a solid stone support, as for a bridge
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Building work that punches a hole through masonry at the front of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To pierce is to puncture or perforate.

clue.text: Law as removed from contract

indicators.note: removed from means the word as is taken out of the shrinking word

parts.note: to contract is to decrease, to shrink

explanation.surface: A legal provision has been struck out of an agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' looks like a legal document but is the verb to shrink.
explanation.definitionFit: A decree is an official order having the force of law.

clue.text: Do be kind to cheat, getting a red card

parts.note: to have someone is to trick them
hearts are a red suit in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A plea for mercy towards a footballer who cheated and was sent off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'red card' sounds like a football sending-off, but it is a playing card of the red suit.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is a plea to show compassion.

clue.text: Familiarity provides cover for this romancer

indicators.note: the word Familiarity covers, conceals, the letters inside it

explanation.surface: Getting to know someone well shields a teller of tall tales.
explanation.definitionFit: A romancer in the old sense is a fabricator of fanciful stories, so an untruthful person.

clue.text: Valuable violin — not the first — needed for jazz

indicators.note: not the first means the opening letter is removed

parts.note: a Strad is a Stradivarius, a prized violin

explanation.surface: A jazz band needs a priceless violin, though not the top one.
explanation.definitionFit: Trad is short for traditional jazz, the New Orleans style.

clue.text: Many items at auction

definitions.meaning: each item sold at auction is a lot

explanation.surface: Plenty of goods are going under the hammer.
explanation.definitionFit: Lots means a large quantity, and a lot is a sale item numbered at an auction.

clue.text: Split in the course of row? That's become more fashionable

indicators.note: in the course of means the split goes inside the row

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
to rend is to tear apart, split

explanation.surface: A quarrel splitting a group, which has somehow made it chic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' suggests a quarrel but is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Trendy means fashionable; the comparative form matches 'more fashionable'.

clue.text: Journey made by newly-wed heading off

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a bride is a woman just married

explanation.surface: A newly married woman setting off on a honeymoon trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A ride is a trip on horseback or in a vehicle.

clue.text: Assessed by the tailor as 'regular'?

definitions.meaning: a tailor takes a customer's dimensions with a tape
a regular, steady rhythm or pace

explanation.walkthrough: 'regular' hints at a standard clothing size but means steady, as in a measured tread.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailor sizes up a client with a tape; a measured pace is steady and even.
